notes: Hub litert-community/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B (upload commit 9d7638b2, 2026-10-13 23:16 JST; the tree's sha256 read back equal to the lane's shipped files, litertlm-convert minicpmv47_work/LANE.md §3). These rows are the lane's round-9 runs on the shipped bytes (K/out/ship, litertlm-convert minicpmv47_work/r9): the card's commands plus the manifest checks (r9/card_cmd_runlog.txt) and the mini re-gate (r9/regate/), one fresh process each, greedy (--temperature 0 where the gate script sets it), Mac Studio M4 Max. No benchmark ran on these bytes, so the throughput cells are null. The shipped files are a metadata-only re-pack of the files the lane measured (round 9: the chat template ends an assistant turn at <|im_end|> and puts its newline at the head of the next turn, so a second turn prefills the upstream template's tokens); the swap reports (r9/swap_MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-VL_int8.json) read TFLite raw bytes, tokenizer and ExecutorMetadata identical (tflite_weights_byte_identical True, llm_metadata_only_template_changed True); a single-turn prompt renders the same text before and after (r9/template_check_r9.json). For contrast (#174(3): numbers of the measured pre-repack file 31ad7861…, not rows): litert-lm 0.18.0 `benchmark -p 256 -d 256 --runs 3 --cache no` in a quiet window (r3/logs/bench.log): CPU prefill 624.72 / decode 42.65 tok/s, TTFT 0.4494 s, init 44.9594 s; GPU (WebGPU on Metal) 2038.66 / 146.72 tok/s, TTFT 0.1348 s, init 47.735 s; one image question in a cold process 16.49 s wall on the CPU, 25.89 s with the decoder on the GPU (`--cache no` engine compile); gates on those bytes: 8 questions CPU 8/8 regex, GPU 7/8 regex with the miss = the fp32 model's own answer (r3/gate8q_*.json, the lane's rule), BANANA hermetic 40/40 (r3/banana_cpu.json), image suite 9/9 grounded on CPU and on GPU (r3/GATE.md). The phone and iPhone rows of that file are staged (data/device_runs_staging, prebuilt-adac974b / selfbuilt-3dbb23e1e / 0.16.0 2026-10-13). Every GPU process logs `TopK requires src tensor C dimension to be divisible by 4.` (vocab 248094): the GPU sampler works on the first 248,092 logits (the two video timestamp tokens drop out of its candidates) and still samples on the GPU — padding the logits to 248,096 removed the line and changed Mac GPU decode by −0.51 % (r6/bench.md).
quantization: decoder: dynamic-range int8 weights on 151 fully connected layers including the untied output head, the 36 GatedDeltaNet decay/gate projections (in_proj_a, in_proj_b) kept float, fp32 activation preference; token embedding int8 per channel, outside the decoder graph; vision encoder and adapter fp16 weights (FULLY_CONNECTED and CONV_2D), float compute
